items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: I played with Paggio many times at Budweiser Many, many jobs at different places

ctx.x: Well, what about Kid Rene? You worked with him some, I think you're talking about. Oh yeah, I worked with Rene.

A whole lot of different jobs, yeah. Well, I worked with putting all the musicians in the city, especially if your musicians come up in my time, you know. Like Willie Paggio, Kid Rene, all them parts like that, Punch and all of them.
Well, what about Rene? What band did he in? Where did he work? Well, Rene worked all different places, you know.
